business_summary: CARE Ratings Limited, a credit rating agency, provides various rating and related services in India and internationally. It offers rating services for bank loan, debt instrument, bonds, long and short term instruments, InvITs, resolution plan, and non-convertible debentures; CDs for banks, bonds, mutual funds, and hybrid instruments; bank debt and capital market instruments, such as commercial papers, corporate bonds and debentures, and structured credit; structured finance ratings; insurance ratings; recovery ratings; issuer ratings; ratings of REITs; public finance; and monitoring agency for equity capital. The company was formerly known as Credit Analysis and Research Limited and changed its name to CARE Ratings Limited in June 2017. CARE Ratings Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
